description: A Python script for fetching GitHub sponsorship data via GraphQL API, processing it, and updating a YAML file with sponsors information. It includes API calls, data processing, and git operations.

classes.name: SponsorEntity
classes.description: Represents a sponsor entity with login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: Tier
classes.description: Represents sponsorship tier details including name and monthly price.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainerNode
classes.description: Node containing sponsor entity and tier info within sponsorship graph.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainerEdge
classes.description: Edge structure holding cursor and node for pagination.

classes.name: SponsorsUser
classes.description: User data containing sponsorships as maintainer.

classes.name: SponsorsResponseData
classes.description: Root data structure for GraphQL response containing user info.

classes.name: SponsorsResponse
classes.description: Top-level response model encapsulating data field.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration class for storing tokens, repository info, and timeout.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_graphql_response( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Makes a POST request to GitHub GraphQL API and returns parsed data, handling errors.

methods.name: list[SponsorshipAsMaintainerEdge] get_graphql_sponsor_edges( *, settings: Settings, after: str | None = None )
methods.description: Fetches sponsor edges with pagination from GraphQL API.

methods.name: defaultdict[float,dict[str,SponsorEntity]] get_individual_sponsors( settings: Settings, )
methods.description: Collects all sponsor nodes, groups by tier price, and returns a nested dictionary.

methods.name: bool update_content(*, content_path: Path, new_content: Any)
methods.description: Reads, compares, and updates a YAML file if content has changed.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main script execution: fetches data, updates YAML, manages git operations, and creates PR.

ctags.name: get_graphql_response
ctags.signature: ( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: str | None = None, )

ctags.name: get_graphql_sponsor_edges
ctags.signature: ( *, settings: Settings, after: str | None = None )

ctags.pattern: /^def update_content(*, content_path: Path, new_content: Any) -> bool:$/
